brief:
Maan Wire reported Palestinian officials offering seasonal greetings as the new year approached, expressing wishes that the coming period will bring freedom, peace, and stability to the Palestinian people. The message was framed around traditional holiday well-wishes repeated annually.

The greeting reflected longstanding Palestinian aspirations for an end to conflict and the establishment of secure conditions. Officials used the occasion to reiterate commitments to these core goals, though no specific policy initiatives or developments were announced in conjunction with the message.
title: Palestinian officials extend holiday greetings amid hopes for freedom and peace
